title: GTA 6 Drops in 11 Days. The Money Is Insane.
description:
GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026. GTA V made $815.7 million in 24 hours. How much could GTA 6 make, is the $1 billion sick-day claim real, does Take-Two stock pop on launches, and what did $10 a day in Take-Two since GTA V turn into?

0:00 Cold open
1:24 The price
2:20 How big could it get?
3:08 Will America call in sick?
3:50 Does the stock pop?
4:58 The Mongki backtest
6:17 The launch-day twist
6:45 Three scenarios
7:31 Outro

Sources:
- Guinness World Records: GTA V sales records (2013)
- Yahoo Finance, June 25, 2026: GTA 6 price, editions, pre-load date, analyst estimates
- TheStreet, Oct 22, 2026: Sensor Tower pre-order data, sick-day claim, Bloomberg/analyst revenue estimates
- Take-Two investor releases: net bookings guidance

- Daily price data: Yahoo Finance (TTWO, NTDOY, SONY, SPY)
